dog.description_text:
What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

It is unknown if I have ever lived with other animals or children.

I would do best in a home without very tiny humans, although I could be open to older human children once I meet them.

I am playful and cute!

A Volunteer Wrote: Are you having a day where you could use a hug? Mylo's got you covered. Maybe a kiss or two? Check. And if you prefer a little more personal space, this charming boy is more than happy to sit next to you and lean in. He was phenomenal with other passing dogs in the park and wants to make friends with everyone he meets. We are absolutely enchanted by him and know you will be, as well!
dog.name: Mylo
